## About
Mad Hatter's House of Games has been a staple for collectible card game, board game and role playing game players in Lubbock for a long time. Our regulars include board gamers, card players, war gamers, role players and miniature players.
We've got room for gaming product and seats for playing, so you can buy a game and sit right down with it. One reviewer called it a fantastic place for adults, families and older kids to hang out.
Come on in and you will feel at home.

## Services
- Trading card games: A strong focus on trading card games, with reviewers mentioning MtG, Pokemon and One Piece.
- Board games: A wide selection of board games to take home or play here.
- Role playing games: Tabletop role-playing games and books for your next campaign.
- Miniatures and paints: A full wall of D&D minis with a decent selection of paints.
- Events: Special events and weekly events for the community.
- Gaming space: Over 11,000 square feet of gaming product and space.

## FAQ
Q: Do you stay open late for events?
A: Yes. Our listed hours are minimums, and we stay open later as required by tournaments or events. Please call if you're unsure whether we're still open.

Q: Are you open on holidays?
A: We're closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.

Q: Is it a good place to bring the family?
A: One reviewer called it a fantastic place for adults, families and older kids to hang out.

## What customers say
- "Mad Hatter’s House of Games is a great store with an incredible selection of tabletop role-playing games and board games, along with a strong focus on trading card games. There is not much in the way of tabletop wargaming, but I appreciate that the store concentrates on doing certain things exceptionally well rather than trying to be a jack of all trades.

The staff has always been kind and courteous, and Hatter, the owner, is especially welcoming and helpful. One practice I particularly appreciate is that the store does not inflate the prices of out-of-print board games and TTRPG products. I have been able to purchase expansions that were no longer in print at their original retail price rather than paying the significantly higher prices found online. After speaking with the staff, I understand that this is an intentional choice, which says a great deal about how they treat their customers.

I cannot personally speak to how they price TCG singles or sealed products, but my experiences with the rest of the store have consistently been fair and positive. Mad Hatter’s is an excellent place to shop, especially for anyone interested in board games, role-playing games, or trading card games." (William, 5/5)
- "Very awesome tcg shop! I’m from out of town but anytime I get the chance to travel to Lubbock I’m always stopping in! Very friendly staff, including Jason who was working today and had an awesome experience talking with him! They have so much selection from MtG, to Pokemon, to Warhammer they have it all! I would highly recommend popping in, and I will continue to come back every chance I get when I’m in town!" (Hank Dropps, 5/5)
- "An extraordinary shop. A full wall of D&D minis (no GW products however) with a decent selection of paints. A fantastic selection of board games and tabletop books. When I was there it looked like they had some One Piece tourneys and plenty of tables for Magic and Commander. Very pleased to find the place." (joshua yancey, 5/5)
- "Fantastic store. Amazing selection, staff is incredibly friendly and helpful to everyone. It's a fantastic place for adults, families, older kids to hang out. Lots of events for the community as well." (Rain Elizabeth, 5/5)
- "Pokemon inventory is small but the wide variety of card make up for it. The worker there are all really nice! And I would recommend anyone collecting to vist!" (Ashiestiel Vi, 5/5)
